author: ashish.indora
name: red-in-black
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Flow field style, generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#02010A, #04052E, #3D2C8D, #916BBF). Features: cursor-reactive (spotlight). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
